meta.label: Earth-2: run forecast
meta.description: Send an initial condition to the FourCastNet NIM and store the forecast steps and a manifest in a managed folder.

inputRoles.name: initial_conditions
inputRoles.label: Initial conditions folder
inputRoles.description: Output of the 'fetch initial conditions' recipe

params.name: init_time
params.label: Init time (UTC)
params.description: Leave empty to use the latest initial condition present in the input folder

params.name: simulation_length
params.label: Simulation length (steps)
params.description: Number of 6-hour steps. N steps produce N+1 files (lead 0 is the initial state)

params.name: variables
params.label: Variables
params.description: Comma-separated. Leave empty for all model variables (~300 MB per step)

params.name: fail_on_partial
params.label: Fail on partial forecast
params.description: If unchecked, a stream that breaks after at least one step keeps the partial run and the recipe succeeds with a warning
